creator: Alexander Terp
description:
amterp, Chat Notes 2026-10-28: "consider agy support". Low priority, he said at triage on 2026-11-01.

`agy` is Google's Antigravity CLI, a terminal coding agent. Muster already reads its state off the screen (`crates/muster-detect/manifests/antigravity.toml`, synced 2026-06-24), but `docs/cli/harnesses.md` lists it among "every other harness", which gets nothing beyond that. An adapter would give it what Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode get: its own report of its state, its context and model, rings at an empty prompt, and its session resumed after a restart. Start by finding out what hooks or plugin interface `agy` offers and how it names and resumes a session. Under MIP-5, a harness with an adapter also gets a `./dev` tier of its own.
title: Antigravity CLI (agy): an adapter, as Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode have
